title.value: An Act to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

reference.provenance: 2025-2026 Regular Sessions, Introduced by M. of A. GALLAGHER, STERN, GONZALEZ-ROJAS, JACOBSON, LEVENBERG, SIMON, SIMONE, ROSENTHAL, COLTON, REYES, SHIMSKY, RAGA, CLARK, SEAWRIGHT, FORREST, OTIS, BURDICK, MAMDANI, MEEKS -- read once and referred to the Committee on Environmental Conservation -- committee discharged, bill amended, ordered reprinted as amended and recommitted to said committee

pfas_definition.provenance: means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

date.provenance: After December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-six

who.provenance: no person shall sell or offer for sale

action.provenance: shall not sell or offer for sale

products.provenance: anti-fogging sprays or wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The regulation does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'

intentionally_added.provenance: prohibits the intentional addition of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
